description: Use to turn a set of questions into a schema of a kind: GeoThought's model groups and orders them; nothing is saved. Give `question_ids` of saved questions and/or `questions` objects, and optionally a `goal`. Returns the arranged schema. A schema is {kind: mindmap|relation|thoughtgraph, name, description?, questions: [Question], tree?, edges?}. A Question is {id (short, unique in the schema), text, answer_type: boolean|enum|numeric|date|text|place|list|relation, label?, enum_values? (enum), unit? (numeric), relation? {subject_type, predicate, object_type} (relation), context?, temporal?, spatial?}. A mindmap's tree is [{title, question?: <question id>, children?: [...]}]; a thought graph's edges are [{source: <question id>, target: <question id>, condition}] (the answer that leads on).
name: geothought_arrange_schema
title: Arrange questions into a schema
